_about: ASSET-001 Hive Brute kitbash: every add-on is an UNMODIFIED vanilla mesh + its vanilla material on one Troll bone. For each part: create an ANCHOR as a child of `parent` with localPosition/localRotation/localScale (Runic armor_attach convention: localScale 1/130 cancels the Troll's x130 bone chain, localRotation undoes the bone's REST rotation, so the anchor is world-aligned in the rest pose), then a child carrying the vanilla mesh with `part_localRotation` / `part_localScale` (Unity axes) at position 0. Units: Unity, the Troll prefab's REST pose (= bind turned 180 deg about Y).
